description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing North Pole Patrol to become a Dwarf until end of turn
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Repeat from step 2
